properties.site-address: Jools Laundry, Tinklers Bank, East of Corbridge Station
properties.notes: Land adjacent to Corbridge railway station that is partly occupied, the remainder being vacant. Mixed-use redevelopment of the site is has now been permitted (14/04259/FUL). This will provide 12 townhouses and 6 apartments alongside commercial/industrial uses. Development is yet to start but forecast for completion within the next 5 years. The extant permission includes consent for 585m2 of non-residential floorspace (390m2 industrial workshops/offices, 195m2 commercial laundry).
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
